chunks: And Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said:
"Whoever prays two rak‘ahs at the Station, they are equivalent to freeing six souls."

key_terms.الْمَقَامِ: the Station, meaning the sacred Maqam associated with Ibrahim عليه السلام
key_terms.عَدَلَتَا: they are equal in reward or equivalent
key_terms.عِتْقَ: the act of freeing or emancipating

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying two rak‘ahs at the Station of Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great merit of performing two rak‘ahs at al-Maqam, referring to the Station of Ibrahim. It emphasizes the immense reward of this act in hajj worship by comparing it to the freeing of six human beings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever prays two Rak’ahs at the Station of Ibrahim, it is equivalent to freeing six souls."
